digest.component_or_area: structured-output orchestration and Pydantic AI seams
propositions: Reconstruct Rebar's structured-output behavioral contract from 15 historical ticket aliases and existing test suite, then validate against Pydantic AI 1.107.2 real seams without live model calls.

Deterministically repair, retry, and extract schema/sentinel outputs using Pydantic primitives while preserving three-attempt ceiling, stop-reason fast-fail, derived request budgets, and terminal refusal/content-filter handling.

Aggregate successful-retry operation usage into single row telemetry; re-raise only exact Rebar-owned output errors found in Pydantic cause chain on exhaustion; emit candidate-attempt observability through trace instrumentation not usage counters.
Omit complete failed response from retry prompt only when deterministic context-window fit is proven; otherwise omit whole response and never prefix-truncate or mutate stored history.

One operation-wide Pydantic request_limit shared by tool turns and output-validation retries with explicit raise-the-limit follow-up if legitimate recovery is starved; bounded output-size retry with concise-response guidance.

Seven Phase-4 maintainer decisions approved: operation-wide request budget, complete-or-omit failed-response policy, aggregate usage, cause-chain exception translation, terminal filter/refusal, concise-size guidance, and trace-based candidate observability.
